title: Synthetic renewal start and remaining expiry margin
method: Fictional 90-day certificate: nominal remaining margin = 90 minus renewal start day. The values 30, 15, and 5 days exclude validation and deployment delay and clock tolerance. Not a CA lifetime recommendation.
alt: Synthetic renewal start and remaining expiry margin. Illustrative values: Renew day 60 30 days, Renew day 75 15 days, Renew day 85 5 days.
